create_checker_texture: create a checkerboard texture on a MuJoCo geom using TextureModder set_checker with two RGB colors
randomize_material_properties: randomize specularity, shininess, and reflectance of a geom using MaterialModder rand_all method
set_light_position: set the position of a named light in a MuJoCo simulation using LightModder set_pos method
modify_camera_orientation: modify a camera quaternion and position in a MuJoCo sim using CameraModder set_quat and set_pos
apply_gradient_texture: apply a linear gradient texture to a geom using TextureModder set_gradient with start and end colors
